  (t : Finset β) [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup δ] [inst_2 : OrderBot δ] (g : γ → δ),

items.informal_description: For a binary function $ f : \alpha \to \beta \to \gamma $, finite sets $ s \subseteq \alpha $ and $ t \subseteq \beta $, and a function $ g : \gamma \to \delta $ where $ \delta $ is a sup-semilattice with bottom element, the supremum of $ g $ applied to the image of $ f $ over $ s \times t $ satisfies $ \sup_{(x,y) \in s \times t} g(f(x,y)) = \sup_{x \in s} \left( \sup_{y \in t} g(f(x,y)) \right) $.
